description: For every file the Gate B migration inventory classified as destined for membrane-research (and sourced from origin/main, i.e. actually present on this cleanup branch), checks whether it is required by the maintained build (CMakeLists.txt), maintained tests (tests/unit, CMakeLists.txt test block), maintained CI (.github/workflows/*.yml), or maintained release verification (scripts/prepare-release.sh and the scripts it invokes) before authorizing removal. Real finding: the original inventory's classification of tools/membrane-kv-*, benchmarks/**, paper/**, and docs/phase*.md as research-only was WRONG in the sense that mattered for this repository -- all four are load-bearing for the maintained build/test/CI/release pipeline, discovered by this audit, not assumed. Only a much smaller set (outreach/**, scripts/verify-outreach.py, tools/membrane-fpga-runtime/**, rtl/tb/tb_q8_scale.sv, experiments/EXP-FPGA-DIV-001/**) is actually free of such a dependency and is removed in the companion commit.
v0.1.0_research_tag_check: untouched -- this audit and the removal it authorizes only ever operate on the working tree of chore/repository-focus-and-research-split; no tag was read, moved, or altered.
